newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline falls again on NYMEX, good supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline falls again on NYMEX, good supply.

text.p: NWE gasoline fell on Monday amid signs of a growing supply picture and following sharp late falls in New York on Friday, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded at $188 a tonne fob AR and $189 fob ARA, $7 to $8 below the weakest deal on Friday.

A recently closed arbitrage window to the U.S. has bottled up product in Europe and a tight shipping picture has also closed off the Mediterranean as a potential outlet, despite the scarcity of supply in that region.
An Italian refiner was expected to sell on Monday a 20,000 tonne cargo of unleaded 95 RON gasoline, containing three percent benzene, to an Italian end user, at around quotes fob high +$2.50.
Perhaps three other outstanding requirements for this month were seen from end users for mixed grades in the Med on Monday.
